capabilities.popcount: popcount(unsigned_declared_signal), width 1..256, returns unsigned 32-bit count; X/Z propagates
capabilities.expressions: native SV integer literals, unsigned declared ports/history, arithmetic, bitwise, logical, comparison, ternary, constant indexing/concatenation; elaborator rejects malformed expressions
capabilities.signedness: ports/history and popcount return unsigned; other operators and sized/unsized integer literals use Icarus SystemVerilog sizing and signedness; no real/string/cast/user functions
capabilities.sampling: posedge pre-NBA; delay d checks consequent(t) iff antecedent(t-d); overlapping triggers independently queued
capabilities.reset: active-low asynchronous reset clears pending antecedents; no checks while reset; observer pN values zero-filled on sampled reset as legacy, qualification includes sampled reset
capabilities.history: no inherited antecedents before initialization; pending at end is recorded, not silently passed; pN explicit zero-initialized copies, not native $past
capabilities.disable: only supplied reset; enable is an ordinary signal; custom disable iff unsupported
capabilities.unknown: four-state SV computes CHECK; X/Z in active trace or CHECK yields unknown and is not an effective simulation
unsupported: popcount of general expressions, slices or signed values
